# Paul's Notes
> Open educational reference for cancer research, biomedical statistics, computational biology, machine learning, R, Python, Rust and reproducible research. Current worked examples emphasize synthetic breast cancer data; the repository is not limited to breast cancer.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes
Human overview: https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/README.md
Machine navigation: https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/docs/machine-index.md

## Computational Oncology textbook
- [Book navigation](https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/oncology/README.md): canonical reader entrypoint
- [Purpose-led introduction](https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/oncology/INTRODUCTION.md): why oncology research and why these methods
- [CO-01 cancer biology](https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/oncology/chapters/CO-01-cancer-biology.md): draft first chapter
- [CO-02 clinical oncology data](https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/oncology/chapters/CO-02-clinical-oncology-data.md): draft clinical endpoints and data schema
- [CO-03 molecular foundations](https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/oncology/chapters/CO-03-molecular-foundations.md): draft omics and biomarker interpretation
- [CO-04 data literacy](https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/oncology/chapters/CO-04-data-literacy.md): draft observation grains and leakage controls
- [Readable source bibliography](https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/oncology/evidence/SOURCES.md): verified reference links by subject
- [Section source register](https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/oncology/evidence/source-registry.json): direct evidence URLs and claim scope
- [Section citation index](https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/oncology/evidence/section-citations.json): H2/H3 source crosswalk
- [Evidence policy](https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/oncology/evidence/README.md): scientific and editorial citation gates
- [Book manifest](https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/oncology/book-manifest.json): 60 chapter IDs, paths, statuses and prerequisites
- [Textbook roadmap](https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/oncology/ROADMAP.md): architecture and milestones

## Primary routes
- [Cancer research scope](https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/docs/cancer-research-scope.md): broad oncology use cases and boundaries
- [Biomedical statistics decision guide](https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/03_learning/biomedical-statistics-decision-guide.md): select analyses by variable type and design
- [Research workflow](https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/docs/research-workflow.md): protocols, reproducibility, data admission
- [Machine learning guide](https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/04_machine_learning/README.md): validation, models and worked examples
- [Visual ML data guide](https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/04_machine_learning/visual-data-guide.md): train/validation separation
- [Rust learning course](https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/03_learning/rust/README.md): foundations through biomedical engineering
- [Biomedical coding](https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/02_biomedical_coding/README.md): research software methods
- [Genomics resources](https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/06_RESOURCES/Genomics/README.md): gene biology and current worked example
- [Literature resources](https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/06_RESOURCES/Literature/README.md): evidence and literature review entrypoint
- [Research milestones](https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/docs/roadmap-gates.md): implementation gates and evidence
- [Machine-readable milestone ledger](https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/docs/milestone-evidence.toml): authoritative structured status; verify current text and evidence

## Agent and retrieval cautions
- Learning examples, test passes, published evidence and clinically validated results are distinct categories.
- Synthetic assay data must never be described as real TCGA or participant records.
- TCGA-BRCA is an example source under study, not a blanket admission or data-access authorization.
- Do not infer clinical accuracy, regulatory clearance, or safety from passing code tests.
- Verify primary references and the current gate ledger before stating implementation or scientific status.
- Never publish credentials, private records, or controlled-access participant data.
- Prefer stable repository paths and actual source text over summaries generated from the index.
